_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:menu_translation/coldbreathng:SKSE/.BlacklistAddDisabledHelp: Type an actor name or editor ID first
line:menu_translation/coldbreathng:SKSE/.BlacklistEmpty: Blacklist is empty. Type an actor name or editor ID above and click Add.
line:menu_translation/coldbreathng:SKSE/.BlacklistRemoveHelp: Remove this entry from the blacklist
line:menu_translation/coldbreathng:SKSE/.BlacklistSectionHelp: Actors whose name or editor ID matches an entry here (case-insensitive, partial match) never get cold breath.
line:menu_translation/coldbreathng:SKSE/.BreathSectionHelp: Control who breathes cold air, how often, and when it starts. Changes apply immediately.
line:menu_translation/coldbreathng:SKSE/.DebugHelp: Write verbose diagnostics to the SKSE log. Leave off normally.
line:menu_translation/coldbreathng:SKSE/.EnableNPCBreathHelp: Toggle cold breath on all other creatures, animals and NPCs.
line:menu_translation/coldbreathng:SKSE/.EnablePlayerBreathHelp: Toggle cold breath on the player character.
line:menu_translation/coldbreathng:SKSE/.MaxRateHelp: Fastest breathing speed in breaths per minute. The actual interval is picked randomly between Min and Max.
line:menu_translation/coldbreathng:SKSE/.MinRateHelp: Slowest breathing speed in breaths per minute. Lower means less frequent breathing.
line:menu_translation/coldbreathng:SKSE/.OverrideAddDisabledHelp: Type an actor name or editor ID first
line:menu_translation/coldbreathng:SKSE/.OverrideEditHelp: Select this condition to assign or change its breath type
line:menu_translation/coldbreathng:SKSE/.OverrideEmpty: No override conditions. Add one above, then pick a breath type below and click Add.
line:menu_translation/coldbreathng:SKSE/.OverrideSectionHelp: Force a specific breath type on actors whose name or editor ID matches a condition (case-insensitive, partial match). Example: add "bear" as a condition, then select Canine and click Add so bears use the canine breath effect.
line:menu_translation/coldbreathng:SKSE/.OverrideTypeAddDisabledHelp: Add an override condition or click Edit on one first
line:menu_translation/coldbreathng:SKSE/.SprintMultHelp: How much faster actors breathe while sprinting or in combat. 3 means three times as often. Range 1 to 10.
